about: GET /api/items/of/{wallet}[?title=] (meter/items.py items_of), captured with the explorer and chain scripted. A held item is a token (token_id, catalog_id, mint_ref, derived…) or a skin held as its vault's token (via: vault, no token_id). `reachable` is present only when false: then the wallet could not be enumerated, which is not 'owns nothing'. `not_configured` is a meter with no item contract, where nobody holds an item.

items.why_nothing: this catalog declares no derived fields — a store-shaped entitlement where every copy is identical by design (ITEM-CONTRACT.md §0). Nothing is missing.

held.index_note: `balance_onchain` is an eth_call and is authoritative; the token ids come from the index because no RPC method enumerates them. If these disagree the index is lagging — the items shown are still real, because every one of them was re-read off chain.

sources.held_as_a_vault_token: eth_call balanceOf on each skin's EloSkinVault

held.scope: Items are ERC-721s on chain 4663 — tradable anywhere the chain reaches, by construction. This page is a view of what you hold and never a vault: scry custodies nothing and cannot move an item. Attributes are not stored anywhere; they are derived from each token's mintRef by the published spec, so anyone can recompute them without us.

could_not_look.error: could not enumerate this wallet's items: timeout after 6.6s
could_not_look.why_it_matters: this is 'we could not look', not 'you own nothing' — the two are different claims and this surface will not merge them.

not_configured.why: no item contract is configured, so no wallet can hold one of its items yet.
not_configured.arms_with: EloItem:GATES in contracts/deployments.json (or SCRY_ITEM=0x… on the meter), after the catalog's creator deploys EloItem. The house does not hold a key on a creator's contract (ITEM-CONTRACT.md §1); for its own catalogs it IS the creator.
not_configured.what_exists: the contract is written and compiles (contracts/src/EloItem.sol); the derivation spec is live at GET /api/items/provenance and needs no contract at all.
